headings.reviewNote: Imposes limitation periods for contesting the validity of a trust revocable at death: earliest of two years after death, six months after notice, or probate will contest deadline.

headings.title: Permissible recipients of trustee notice and instrument
headings.reviewNote: Permits the trustee, for subsection 1(2) notice purposes, to provide the trust copy and notice to persons entitled to estate notice under section 473.033 and persons whose interests the trustee believes are adversely affected.

headings.title: Trustee distribution authority and immunity exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Permits the trustee to distribute trust property upon the settlor's death without liability unless knowing of a pending contest or notified of a possible contest commenced within sixty days of notification.

headings.title: Beneficiary liability to return invalid distributions
headings.reviewNote: Holds a beneficiary of a trust determined to be invalid liable to return any distribution received.

entries.reviewSummary: Limitation periods for contesting revocable trusts after death, permissible notice recipients, trustee distribution immunity and 60-day contest exception, and beneficiary duty to return invalid distributions.

headings.title: Methods of accepting designated trusteeship
headings.reviewNote: Specifies methods of accepting trusteeship by substantially complying with trust methods or by accepting delivery, exercising powers, or performing duties.

headings.title: Rejection of trusteeship and deemed rejection
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a designated trustee to reject trusteeship, and deems trusteeship rejected if not accepted within a reasonable time after notice of designation.

headings.title: Preservation of trust property without accepting trusteeship
headings.reviewNote: Permits a designated trustee to act to preserve trust property or inspect assets to determine liability without thereby accepting the trusteeship.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 456.7-701 governing acceptance methods, rejection procedures, and protective safe harbors without accepting trusteeship.

headings.title: Bond requirement only when ordered or specified
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a trustee is required to give bond to secure performance only if required by trust terms or found necessary by the court.

headings.title: Court authority to set, modify, or terminate bond
headings.reviewNote: Permits the court to specify bond amount, liabilities, and sureties, and to modify or terminate a bond at any time.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.7-702 providing trustee bond requirements and court discretion to adjust or excuse bond.

headings.title: Action by majority of cotrustees
headings.reviewNote: Requires cotrustees to act by majority decision.

headings.title: Action by remaining cotrustees during vacancy
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remaining cotrustees to act for the trust if a vacancy occurs in a cotrusteeship.

headings.title: Duty of cotrustee to participate in functions
headings.reviewNote: Requires a cotrustee to participate in performing trustee functions unless unavailable due to absence, illness, legal disqualification, or temporary incapacity, or unless properly delegated.

headings.title: Remaining cotrustees acting during temporary unavailability
headings.reviewNote: Permits remaining cotrustee or a majority of remaining cotrustees to act when a cotrustee is unavailable and prompt action is necessary to achieve trust purposes or avoid injury.

headings.title: Delegation of functions to cotrustee and revocation
headings.reviewNote: Permits a trustee to delegate performance of a function to a cotrustee under section 456.8-807(1) and to revoke a prior delegation unless irrevocable.

headings.title: Non-liability of non-joining cotrustee
headings.reviewNote: Except as provided in subsection 7, shields a trustee who does not join in another trustee's action from liability for that action.

headings.title: Duty to prevent or redress serious breach
headings.reviewNote: Requires each trustee to exercise reasonable care to prevent a cotrustee from committing a serious breach of trust and to compel a cotrustee to redress a serious breach.

headings.title: Protection for dissenting trustee joining majority action
headings.reviewNote: Shields a dissenting trustee who joins in an action at majority direction after notifying any cotrustee of dissent at or before the action, unless the action is a serious breach of trust.

entries.reviewSummary: Cotrustee majority decision-making, vacancies, participation duty, action during unavailability, delegation and revocation, non-joining immunity, duty to prevent serious breaches, and dissenting trustee protection.

headings.title: Events resulting in vacancy in trusteeship
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates events creating a vacancy in trusteeship, including rejection, resignation, disqualification, removal, death, or incapacity.

headings.title: Filling vacancy in cotrusteeship
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a vacancy in a cotrusteeship need not be filled unless the trust terms require it or no cotrustee remains in office.

headings.title: Priority order for appointing successor trustee
headings.reviewNote: Establishes priority for filling required trusteeship vacancies: person designated under trust terms, person appointed by a majority in number of qualified beneficiaries, or court appointment.

headings.title: Court appointment of additional trustee or fiduciary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to appoint an additional trustee or special fiduciary whenever considered necessary for trust administration, whether or not a vacancy exists.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 456.7-704 defining vacancies in trusteeship, cotrustee vacancy rules, appointment priority, and court appointments.

headings.title: Notice requirements or court approval for resignation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a trustee to resign upon at least 30 days' notice to qualified beneficiaries, living settlor, and cotrustees, or with court approval.

headings.title: Court orders and conditions on resignation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court in approving a resignation to issue protective orders and impose conditions necessary to safeguard trust property.

headings.title: Preservation of liability of resigning trustee
headings.reviewNote: Provides that resignation does not discharge or affect any liability of the resigning trustee or sureties for prior acts or omissions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 456.7-705 governing trustee resignation procedures via 30-day notice or court order, court conditions, and survival of liability.

headings.title: Standing and court authority to remove trustee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the settlor, a cotrustee, or a qualified beneficiary to request removal of a trustee, or the court to remove and replace a trustee on its own initiative.

headings.title: Grounds for court removal of trustee
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates grounds for trustee removal including serious breach, lack of cooperation, unfitness/unwillingness, reduced services, or unanimous beneficiary request.

headings.title: Procedures and exceptions for corporate trustee replacement
headings.reviewNote: Specifies replacement procedures when removing corporate trustees or under unanimous request, with exceptions for pre-2005 instruments containing removal terms.

headings.title: Interim judicial relief pending removal decision
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to order appropriate interim relief to protect trust property or beneficiary interests pending a removal decision.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 456.7-706 specifying standing, statutory grounds, replacement procedures, and interim relief for trustee removal.

headings.title: Powers and duties of former trustee pending delivery
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a former trustee retains the duties and powers necessary to protect trust property until it is delivered to a successor or entitled person.

headings.title: Duty to expeditiously deliver trust property
headings.reviewNote: Directs a resigned or removed trustee to proceed expeditiously to deliver trust property in possession to the cotrustee, successor, or entitled person.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.7-707 defining custodial duties and expeditious property delivery obligations of former trustees.

headings.title: Reasonable compensation when trust silent
headings.reviewNote: Entitles a trustee to reasonable compensation under the circumstances if the terms of the trust do not specify compensation.

headings.title: Court adjustment of specified compensation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to allow more or less compensation than specified in trust terms if duties change substantially or compensation is unreasonably low or high.

headings.title: Factors included in reasonable compensation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that reasonable compensation may include fees taking into account administration of both income and principal regardless of instrument provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 456.7-708 governing trustee reasonable compensation, court adjustment of specified fees, and principal/income administration factors.

headings.title: Trustee reimbursement for administration expenses
headings.reviewNote: Entitles a trustee to reimbursement with interest for properly incurred expenses, and for improperly incurred expenses to the extent necessary to prevent unjust enrichment.

headings.title: Lien on trust property for trustee advances
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that an advance of money by the trustee for trust protection creates a lien against trust property to secure reimbursement with reasonable interest.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.7-709 providing trustee rights to expense reimbursement and liens securing protective advances of personal funds.

headings.title: Duty to administer solely for beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that a trustee administer the trust solely in the interests of the beneficiaries.

headings.title: Voidability of transactions affected by conflict of interest
headings.reviewNote: Provides that transactions affected by conflict between fiduciary and personal interests are voidable by beneficiaries, subject to five statutory exceptions.

headings.title: Transactions presumed affected by conflict of interest
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a presumption of conflict for transactions between the trustee and family members, agents, attorneys, or affiliated corporations.

headings.title: Voidability of advantageous non-trust transactions with beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Renders voidable non-trust transactions between trustee and beneficiary from which the trustee obtains advantage unless the trustee proves fairness.

headings.title: Conflict regarding opportunities belonging to trust
headings.reviewNote: Deems a transaction engaged in by the trustee individually to involve a conflict of interest if it concerns an opportunity properly belonging to the trust.

headings.title: Investment transactions not presumed conflicted
headings.reviewNote: Exempts specified financial services, collective funds, and affiliates from conflict presumptions provided investments comply with the prudent investor act.

headings.title: Voting shares and management of enterprise
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee in voting shares or controlling an enterprise to act in the best interests of beneficiaries, including electing qualified directors.

headings.title: Permissible transactions not involving conflicts of interest
headings.reviewNote: Specifies transactions not precluded by the duty of loyalty, such as agreements between trustees and beneficiaries concerning appointment, compensation, or advances.

headings.title: Court appointment of special fiduciary for conflicted transaction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court to appoint a special fiduciary to make decisions regarding proposed transactions that might violate the section.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 9 subsections for 456.8-802 delineating the trustee duty of loyalty, voidable conflicts, affiliate exemptions, voting controls, and special fiduciary appointments.

headings.title: Prudent delegation of duties and powers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a trustee to delegate duties and powers that a prudent trustee of comparable skills could properly delegate, exercising reasonable care in selection and monitoring.

headings.title: Agent duty of reasonable care in delegation
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a duty of reasonable care on the agent in performing delegated functions under the delegation terms.

headings.title: Trustee non-liability for agent conduct
headings.reviewNote: Shields a trustee from liability to beneficiaries or the trust for actions of an agent if the trustee properly selected, established the scope, and monitored the agent.

headings.title: Agent submission to court jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Provides that an agent submits to the jurisdiction of Missouri courts by accepting a delegation of powers or duties from a trustee of a Missouri-administered trust.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 456.8-807 governing prudent delegation of trustee functions, agent duties of care, trustee liability limitations, and court jurisdiction.

headings.title: Direction by settlor contrary to trust terms
headings.reviewNote: Provides that while a trust is revocable, the trustee may follow settlor directions that are contrary to trust terms.

headings.title: Designation of trust protector and directed trust status
headings.reviewNote: Permits a trust instrument to grant express powers to one or more persons (not trustee, settlor, or beneficiary) as a trust protector, deeming the trust a directed trust.

headings.title: Scope and examples of express trust protector powers
headings.reviewNote: Limits a trust protector to expressly granted powers and lists non-exclusive examples including trustee removal/appointment, trust amendment for tax/legal/drafting errors, modifying beneficiary interests, terminating the trust, and changing situs or governing law.

headings.title: Prohibited trust protector modifications
headings.reviewNote: Bars a trust protector from removing a 42 U.S.C. Section 1396p(d)(4) Medicaid payback requirement or reducing/eliminating income interests in marital deduction, charitable remainder, GRAT, or QSST trusts.

headings.title: Tax-savings limit on trust protector exercise
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a trust protector, unless the trust specifically refers to this subsection, from exercising a power in a way causing a federal taxable gift or estate tax inclusion for the trust protector.

headings.title: Fiduciary capacity, exoneration, compensation, and self-benefit ban
headings.reviewNote: Sets default fiduciary capacity (modifiable to nonfiduciary), non-trustee status, exoneration absent preponderance proof of bad faith/reckless indifference, authority to act, reasonable compensation/defense reimbursement, and ban on personal-benefit exercise.

headings.title: Trustee-equivalent duties for directing administrative or investment decisions
headings.reviewNote: Imposes trustee duties and liabilities on a trust protector holding power to direct/consent/disapprove trustee investment, distribution, or administrative decisions (excluding subsection 3 powers), exempts trustees following written investment directions from sections 469.900 to 469.913, and defines investment decisions.

headings.title: Directed trustee absolution and no duty to monitor
headings.reviewNote: Absolves a directed trustee from liability for trust protector acts/omissions or following written directions, requires facilitating protector activity, removes duties to monitor/advise/warn, and shields excluded trustees on directed investments.

headings.title: Trust protector information requests and confidentiality
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee to promptly provide requested trust information related to a protector's express powers for a sufficiently identified single trust (with no unrequested duty), subject to binding confidentiality agreements.

headings.title: Resignation of trust protector and successor powers
headings.reviewNote: Permits a trust protector to resign on thirty days' written notice to the trustee and any successor protector, vesting the successor with all expressly granted powers unless modified.

headings.title: Trust protector submission to Missouri court jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Subjects a trust protector of a Missouri-administered trust personally to Missouri court jurisdiction while serving and permits the trust instrument to make personal jurisdiction a condition of appointment.

entries.reviewSummary: Revocable trust settlor directions, trust protector appointment and express powers, prohibited modifications and tax limits, fiduciary status and exoneration, directed trustee immunity, information rights, resignation, and jurisdiction.

headings.title: Trustee duty to keep adequate administration records
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee to keep adequate records of the administration of the trust.

headings.title: Duty to keep trust property separate
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee to keep trust property separate from the trustee's own property.

headings.title: Identification and titling of trust property
headings.reviewNote: Requires trust property other than fungible property to be designated so that the interest of the trust appears in records of a third party or the trust.

headings.title: Investment of undivided interests from multiple trusts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a trustee to invest as a whole the property of two or more separate trusts if clear undivided interests are maintained.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 456.8-810 governing trustee recordkeeping, property segregation, asset identification, and joint investment of trust assets.

headings.title: Duty to keep qualified beneficiaries reasonably informed
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee to keep qualified beneficiaries reasonably informed about administration and promptly respond to requests for information.

headings.title: Instrument copy, 120-day notices, and fee change notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires promptly furnishing trust copies upon request, notifying qualified beneficiaries within 120 days (source footnote notes 'and' in original rolls) of acceptance or irrevocability, and giving advance notice of compensation changes.

headings.title: Annual and terminal reports to permissible distributees
headings.reviewNote: Requires trustee to send annual reports of trust property, liabilities, receipts, and disbursements to permissible distributees and requesting qualified beneficiaries.

headings.title: Waiver and withdrawal of report entitlement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a beneficiary to waive the right to trustee's reports or other information and withdraw a waiver previously given.

headings.title: Reasonable fee for providing trust information
headings.reviewNote: Permits a trustee to charge a reasonable fee to a beneficiary for providing information under this section.

headings.title: Single-trust identification required for information requests
headings.reviewNote: Requires any beneficiary's request for information under this section to specify a single trust sufficiently identified to enable locating its records.

headings.title: Beneficiary agreement to asset confidentiality restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires a beneficiary eligible to receive information about an asset subject to trustee confidentiality restrictions to agree to be bound by those restrictions before receiving it.

headings.title: Continued application of prior law to pre-2005 trusts
headings.reviewNote: Exempts trusts created under trust instruments that became irrevocable before January 1, 2005, continuing prior law for those trusts.

entries.reviewSummary: Trustee duty to inform and report, 120-day acceptance and irrevocability notices, annual and vacancy reports, beneficiary waivers, reasonable fees, single-trust requests, confidentiality, and pre-2005 trust exemption.

headings.title: Good faith exercise of discretionary power under standard
headings.reviewNote: Requires a trustee to exercise discretionary powers under an ascertainable standard in good faith and in accordance with trust terms, notwithstanding broad language.

headings.title: Restrictions on interested trustee-beneficiary distributions
headings.reviewNote: Restricts an interested trustee who is also a beneficiary to ascertainable standards for self-distributions and prohibits satisfying personal support obligations.

headings.title: Exercise of restricted power by cotrustees or fiduciary
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remaining unrestricted cotrustees to exercise powers restricted under subsection 2, or court appointment of a special fiduciary if all are restricted.

headings.title: Exceptions for marital, revocable, and annual exclusion trusts
headings.reviewNote: Exempts marital deduction trusts, revocable trusts during settlor's life, and Section 2503(c) minor trusts from interested-trustee distribution restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsections for 456.8-814 governing good-faith standards for discretionary powers, tax-savings restrictions on interested trustee-beneficiaries, and statutory exceptions.

headings.title: Powers exercisable by trustee without court authorization
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a trustee without court approval to exercise powers conferred by trust terms, individual ownership powers, management/investment powers, and UTC powers.

headings.title: Exercise of powers subject to fiduciary duties
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the exercise of any trustee power is subject to the fiduciary duties prescribed by sections 456.8-801 to 456.8-814.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.8-815 establishing the trustee's broad general powers exercisable without court authorization and subordination to fiduciary duties.

headings.title: Proposal for distribution and thirty-day objection cutoff
headings.reviewNote: Permits a trustee upon termination or partial termination to send a distribution proposal, cutting off beneficiary objections not made within thirty days after the proposal was sent if the proposal disclosed the right and deadline.

headings.title: Expeditious distribution and retention of reasonable reserve
headings.reviewNote: Requires the trustee to proceed expeditiously to distribute trust property upon termination, reserving reasonable funds for debts, expenses, and taxes.

headings.title: Invalidity of beneficiary release for improper conduct
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates a beneficiary's release of a trustee from liability if induced by improper conduct or made without knowledge of material facts or rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 456.8-817 governing proposals for distribution, expeditious distribution with reasonable reserves, and invalidity of tainted releases.

headings.title: Definition of qualified spousal trust
headings.reviewNote: Defines qualified spousal trust as a trust created by married settlors with terms providing for joint or separate share administration and distributions during joint lives and survivor's life.

headings.title: Permissible additional trust provisions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a qualified spousal trust to contain additional terms not inconsistent with the section, including discretionary distributions to other persons.

headings.title: Tenancy by entirety creditor immunity protections
headings.reviewNote: Extends tenancy by the entirety creditor immunity to property held in a qualified spousal trust during joint lives and survivor's life, ending upon divorce.

headings.title: Definition of property for spousal trust
headings.reviewNote: Defines property to include any interest in property held in a qualified spousal trust, income thereon, and converted proceeds.

headings.title: Distribution upon death of settlor and share transfers
headings.reviewNote: Governs distribution of trust property upon the death of each settlor, transfer of separate shares into irrevocable trusts, and titling designations.

headings.title: Preservation of marital property rights upon dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Provides that transferring or administering property in a qualified spousal trust does not affect marital property rights upon marriage dissolution unless both settlors expressly agree otherwise in writing.

headings.title: Fraudulent transfer act not defeated
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no transfer to a qualified spousal trust shall avoid or defeat the Missouri uniform fraudulent transfer act in chapter 428.

headings.title: Applicability to trusts regardless of creation date
headings.reviewNote: Applies this section to all trusts fulfilling qualified spousal trust criteria regardless of whether created before, on, or after August 28, 2011.

entries.reviewSummary: Qualified spousal trust definition, permissible terms, tenancy-by-entirety creditor immunity, property definition, post-death distributions, preserved marital rights, fraudulent transfer act supremacy, and applicability.

headings.title: Governing law for creation and exercise of power
headings.reviewNote: Provides that creation, revocation, or amendment of a power of appointment is governed by the donor's domicile law, while exercise, release, or disclaimer (and revocation/amendment thereof) is governed by the powerholder's domicile law.

headings.title: Common law and equitable principles as supplement
headings.reviewNote: Directs that the common law and principles of equity supplement the Missouri Uniform Powers of Appointment Act except as modified by statute.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.980 establishing governing law rules for powers of appointment and common law supplementation.

headings.title: Universal governance over powers of appointment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that sections 456.970 to 456.1135 govern powers of appointment except as otherwise provided in the terms of an instrument creating or exercising the power.

headings.title: Mandatory statutory provisions prevailing over instrument terms
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates seven mandatory statutory provisions that prevail over contrary instrument terms, including creation requirements, survival limits, and creditor access.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 456.985 establishing the universal application of the Uniform Powers of Appointment Act and seven mandatory rules prevailing over contrary terms.

headings.title: Requirements for creating power of appointment
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth the requirements for creating a power of appointment: valid instrument, transfer of appointive property, and manifested donor intent.

headings.title: Transfer exception for power created by exercise
headings.reviewNote: Exempts creation of a power of appointment by the exercise of another power of appointment from the separate property transfer requirement.

headings.title: Prohibition against creating power in deceased person
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits creating a power of appointment in a deceased individual.

headings.title: Creation of power in unborn or unascertained person
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes creating a power of appointment in an unborn or unascertained powerholder, subject to applicable rules against perpetuities.

headings.title: Disposition of property subject to invalid power
headings.reviewNote: Directs that property subject to an invalid power of appointment passes in accordance with valid instrument provisions or applicable law.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 subsections for 456.990 specifying requirements for creating powers of appointment, unborn powerholder rules, and disposition of invalidly appointed property.

headings.title: Nontransferability of power of appointment
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a powerholder from transferring a power of appointment to another person.

headings.title: Lapse of power of appointment upon death
headings.reviewNote: Provides that a power of appointment lapses upon the death of the powerholder unless effectively disclaimed, exercised, or released.

headings.title: Post-death survival of general power in personal representative
headings.reviewNote: Permits a general power to survive death in the personal representative during the disclaimer period, defines lapse and operative wording, and exempts personal representatives lacking actual knowledge at least 120 days prior (source footnote notes 'and' in original rolls) absent bad faith.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsections for 456.995 governing nontransferability of powers, lapse upon death, and limited post-death survival in personal representatives.
